friendly_name: Suppress expected drift alerts during rebaseline
purpose_context: When an audited-surface deploy lands seconds before a security-monitor audit tick, the audit sees the expected drift and fires a false error page before felix-deployer's deferred-confirm rebaseline stamps the new baseline. This mission makes the audit consult felix-deployer's pending-rebaseline token so it suppresses or downgrades alerts only for the exact baselines with expected in-flight drift, bounded by the pending window, while still paging immediately on genuinely unexpected drift, preserving the drift channel's credibility.
purpose_tldr: Stop the security-monitor drift audit from paging on deploy drift that felix-deployer has already flagged as expected and is actively rebaselining.
